changeSet.sql: UPDATE system_user_permissions sup JOIN ( SELECT system_user_id, system_permission_id, MIN(id) AS keep_id FROM system_user_permissions WHERE enabled = TRUE GROUP BY system_user_id, system_permission_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) dups ON sup.system_user_id = dups.system_user_id AND sup.system_permission_id = dups.system_permission_id SET sup.enabled = FALSE WHERE sup.id <> dups.keep_id AND sup.enabled = TRUE;

DELETE sup FROM system_user_permissions sup JOIN ( SELECT system_user_id, system_permission_id, MIN(id) AS keep_id FROM system_user_permissions GROUP BY system_user_id, system_permission_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) dups ON sup.system_user_id = dups.system_user_id AND sup.system_permission_id = dups.system_permission_id WHERE sup.id <> dups.keep_id AND sup.enabled = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT id FROM system_user_permissions WHERE enabled = TRUE) act WHERE act.id = dups.keep_id );
